preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty.
The input string must consist only of digits.
The length of the input string must not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be in the format 'a+b=c' where a, b, and c are non-negative integers.
The sum of a and b must equal c.

postconditions.expression: not (a.startswith('0') and len(a) > 1) and not (b.startswith('0') and len(b) > 1) and not (c.startswith('0') and len(c) > 1)
postconditions.description: None of a, b, or c can have leading zeros unless they are single-digit numbers.
